messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: LDLT_factor tests?
parts:
We have a LDLT_factor type that looks like a matrix, but has no tests.

I ran across it while trying to reduce the sign comparison warnings in inv_wishart_test.cpp.

First, we should add unit tests for this class. Marcus, it looks like you built the class, so want to start?

Secondly, it needs to have a typedef size_type so it can play nicely with our meta-template stuff. All of our types that can be forced into templated matrix / vector operations need size_type. We followed the standard library convention there. That's what we define in src/stan/math/matrix/EigenDenseBaseAddons.hpp.



Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: LDLT_factor tests?
parts:
LDLT is an internal only interface/class. It may get shared to other
distribution implementations, but should never see play beyond that.
It would have been in an anonymous namespace except for the fact that
it has matrix and agrad components and is useful in multiple places.
In short, I'm not sure it needs thorough unit testing. I will try to
get some time to add them soon, but I'm almost out of Stan-related
time this week.

Cheers,
Marcus
